name: gta-bedstuy-native
description: Desktop shell (Electron) for GTA Bed-Stuy, a non-commercial fan tribute. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
author: GTA Bed-Stuy fan tribute

scripts.dist:mac: npm run compile && npm run prep && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run compile && npm run prep && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs
